1: // Simple Asteroid Dodge game
2: // Canvas with id="game" must exist in the HTML.
3: (() => {
4:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
5:   // Setup starfield background
6:   const starCount = 100;
7:   const stars = [];
8:   for (let i = 0; i < starCount; i++) {
9:     stars.push({
10:       x: Math.random() * width,
11:       y: Math.random() * height,
12:       r: Math.random() * 2 + 0.5,
13:       speed: Math.random() * 0.5 + 0.2,
14:     });
15:   }
16:   // Audio setup
17:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
18:   function playTone(freq, duration) {
19:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
20:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
21:     osc.type = 'sine';
22:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
23:     osc.connect(gain);
24:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
25:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime);
26:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.2, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.01);
27:     osc.start();
28:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
29:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
30:   }
31:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas #game not found');
32:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
33:   const width = canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
34:   const height = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600;
35: 
36:   // Ship (triangle) definition
37:   const ship = {
38:     x: 80,
39:     y: height / 2,
40:     size: 20,
41:     speed: 4,
42:   };
43: 
44:   // Input handling
45:   const keys = { ArrowUp: false, ArrowDown: false };
46:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
47:     if (e.key in keys) {
48:       keys[e.key] = true;
49:       // Play movement sound
50:       playTone(440, 0.08);
51:     }
52:   });
53:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => { if (e.key in keys) keys[e.key] = false; });
54: 
55:   // Asteroids (circles)
56:   const asteroids = [];
57:   const asteroidFreq = 90; // frames between spawns (approx)
58:   let frameCount = 0;
59:   let score = 0;
60:   const startTime = performance.now();
61: 
62:   function spawnAsteroid() {
63:     const size = Math.random() * 30 + 10;
64:     const speed = Math.random() * 2 + 2; // leftward speed
65:     asteroids.push({
66:       x: width + size,
67:       y: Math.random() * height,
68:       r: size,
69:       speed,
70:     });
71:   }
72: 
73:   function update() {
74:     // Move ship
75:     if (keys.ArrowUp) ship.y -= ship.speed;
76:     if (keys.ArrowDown) ship.y += ship.speed;
77:     // Wrap vertically
78:     if (ship.y < 0) ship.y = height;
79:     if (ship.y > height) ship.y = 0;
80: 
81:     // Spawn asteroids
82:     if (frameCount % asteroidFreq === 0) spawnAsteroid();
83:     frameCount++;
84: 
85:     // Update asteroids
86:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
87:       const a = asteroids[i];
88:       a.x -= a.speed;
89:       if (a.x + a.r < 0) asteroids.splice(i, 1);
90:     }
91: 
92:     // Collision detection (approximate ship as circle)
93:     const shipR = ship.size * 0.6;
94:     for (const a of asteroids) {
95:       const dx = a.x - ship.x;
96:       const dy = a.y - ship.y;
97:       if (dx * dx + dy * dy < (a.r + shipR) ** 2) {
98:         // Game over
99:         cancelAnimationFrame(animId);
100:         // Play crash sound
101:         playTone(100, 0.3);
102:         ctx.fillStyle = 'red';
103:         ctx.font = '48px sans-serif';
104:         ctx.textAlign = 'center';
105:         ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2, height / 2);
106:         return;
107:       }
108:     }
109:   }
110: 
111:   function draw() {
112:     // Draw moving starfield background
113:     // Clear background with dark gradient
114:     const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, height);
115:     bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#001');
116:     bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#000');
117:     ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
118:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
119:     // Update and draw moving starfield
120:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
121:     for (let i = stars.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
122:       const s = stars[i];
123:       s.x -= s.speed;
124:       if (s.x < 0) {
125:         s.x = width;
126:         s.y = Math.random() * height;
127:         s.r = Math.random() * 2 + 0.5;
128:         s.speed = Math.random() * 0.5 + 0.2;
129:       }
130:       ctx.beginPath();
131:       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
132:       ctx.fill();
133:     }
134:     // Draw ship (triangle pointing right) with glow
135:     ctx.save();
136:     ctx.shadowColor = '#0f0';
137:     ctx.shadowBlur = 12;
138:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
139:     ctx.beginPath();
140:     ctx.moveTo(ship.x, ship.y);
141:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x - ship.size, ship.y - ship.size / 2);
142:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x - ship.size, ship.y + ship.size / 2);
143:     ctx.closePath();
144:     ctx.fill();
145:     ctx.restore();
146:     // Draw asteroids with subtle shading
147:     for (const a of asteroids) {
148:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(a.x, a.y, a.r * 0.2, a.x, a.y, a.r);
149:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#bbb');
150:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#555');
151:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
152:       ctx.beginPath();
153:       ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
154:       ctx.fill();
155:     }
156:     // Draw score
157:     score = Math.floor((performance.now() - startTime) / 100);
158:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
159:     ctx.font = '20px sans-serif';
160:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}`, 80, 30);
161:   }
162: 
163:   let animId;
164:   function loop() {
165:     update();
166:     draw();
167:     animId = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
168:   }
169:   loop();
170: })();
